newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - Philips up in New York.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - Philips up in New York.

text.p: Shares in the Netherlands' Philips Electronics NV rose in New York on Tuesday, boosted by a ratings increase.
Philips' stock rose 1-7/8 to 40-1/2 in early trade after Morgan Stanley raised its rating for the company to strong buy from outperform.
Among other American Depositary Receipts, Russia's Vimpel-Communications fell 2-1/4 to 25-3/4, well off its high of 34-1/2 reached shortly after its splashy Wall Street debut on Nov 15.
"It came out of the gate like gangbusters and the enthusiasm is waning a little bit," said Val Kosmider, head of international equity trading at Schroder Wertheim.
British Airways fell 3/4 to 99-3/4 as investors consolidated recent gains. The company's stock has been boosted by prospects for a proposed alliance with AMR Corp's American Airlines.
Among Latin American stocks, Brazilian bellwether Telebras rose 1/4 to 76-1/4.
Decliners led advancers by a margin of 246 to 200 among 807 ADRs. Volume at mid-morning was 32.5 million shares.
